entries.summary: Added casting video URL field on job applications with YouTube thumbnail preview
entries.notes: video_info() helper detects YouTube/Vimeo/other. YouTube shows clickable thumbnail. Stored as _oha_app_video_url meta.

entries.summary: Added richer applicant profile fields: age range, experience, availability, phone, video
entries.notes: app_fields_def() method. All optional. Saved as _oha_app_* meta on oha_job_app posts.

entries.summary: Added inline applicant manager in oha_my_jobs shortcode with Shortlist/Decline AJAX actions
entries.notes: App count becomes toggle button. Panel expands below job item. Status stored as _oha_app_status. New oha_job_applicants shortcode also available standalone.

entries.summary: Rewrote frontend CSS to match OHA Kadence theme using global palette CSS variables
entries.notes: All colors now reference --global-palette1/2/4/6/7/8/9. Dark card bg on maroon page bg pattern matches contact-router and site design language.

entries.summary: Auto-publish toggle: settings checkbox to make job posts go live immediately or require review
entries.notes: Setting key: auto_publish_jobs. When enabled, wp_insert_post uses publish status instead of pending. notify_admin_new_job now accepts  param and adjusts email wording accordingly.

entries.summary: Applicant confirmation email: applicants now receive an automated receipt on submit
entries.notes: Sends to applicant email immediately after successful submission. Subject and body are editable in settings under Messages and Email Templates section. Placeholders: {name}, {job_title}.

entries.summary: Owner notification email now includes all applicant profile fields in the body
entries.notes: Previously only sent name, email, and message. Now includes phone, age range, experience, availability, and casting video URL. Fields are captured into variables before saving so they are available for email template processing.

entries.summary: Six editable message and email template fields added to settings
entries.notes: New settings section: Messages and Email Templates. Fields: apply_success_msg, submit_success_msg, applicant_email_subject, applicant_email_body, owner_email_subject, owner_email_body. All use {placeholder} syntax via fill_template() helper. Blank fields fall back to hardcoded defaults.
